params_override:
#!/bin/sh
# shellcheck disable=SC2154

#param set-default MAV_SYS_ID $((px4_instance+1))
#param set-default IMU_INTEG_RATE 250

set MIXER quad_x
param set EKF2_MULTI_IMU 1
param set EKF2_MULTI_MAG 1
param set SENS_IMU_MODE 1
param set SENS_MAG_MODE 1
param set MPC_THR_HOVER 0.46
param set SDLOG_MODE 2
param set SDLOG_PROFILE 0
param set MC_PITCHRATE_I 0.2000
mavlink_override:
#!/bin/sh
mavlink start -u 14586 -o 14546 -t 127.0.0.1 -r 1000000 -m onboard
mavlink stream -u 14586 -s LOCAL_POSITION_NED -r 50
mavlink stream -u 14586 -s ATTITUDE -r 20
